frontier.hypothesis: Some COMPLETED-C function already on main reproduces an allocated-but-never-touched vars region from ordinary C - without a pad aggregate and without a spill - and its producer is spellable here.
frontier.mechanism: get_frame_size() counts every assign_stack_local slot; a LIVE local whose traffic is folded away after RTL expand leaves an untouched region, and the project has ~1200 matched bodies to census.
frontier.next_probe: Cheap no-compile census: for each matched src/*.c function, read the .frame vars= term from the build asm and count sw/lw traffic inside the vars window; report any function with vars>0 and zero traffic that carries no pad/volatile aggregate. A hit names an unspelled producer; a clean negative is the strongest evidence for the pad-allowlist route.

frontier.hypothesis: The 32 untouched bytes correspond to a LIVE 8-word local in the original TU whose uses this decompilation folded away, shared by all four text1b siblings with the identical region.
frontier.mechanism: function.c assign_stack_local reserves an aggregate slot at RTL-expand and never reclaims frame_offset, so a local that survives to expand but whose uses fold leaves the slot with no traffic.
frontier.next_probe: forensics modality on func_80047EE8 / func_80047FBC / func_800481E8 and their callers/callees: look for a call, struct or buffer shape that implies the same 8-word local (e.g. a stack-built argument record passed around func_800482C8).

frontier.hypothesis: The unwritten volatile pad remains the only known producer of exactly 32 bytes and is blocked only by the closed per-function enumeration in engine/volatile_cheats.py.
frontier.mechanism: engine/volatile_cheats.py::_SANCTIONED_UNWRITTEN_PADS is a per-function frozenset; sibling func_80047EE8 ships exactly this construct on main (src/text1b.c:20-36) under owner ruling 2026-08-18.
frontier.next_probe: None available to a grind session - the bytes-proven body is preserved at memory/grind/func_800480C0/rejected/pad-judge-banned-2026-09-02.c and integrates unchanged if an owner ruling adds the row (Judge FAIL 2026-09-02 04:28, docs/grind/decisions.md:20349).

judge_constraints: func_800480C0 may not carry an unwritten volatile frame pad in any spelling until an owner ruling adds its row to engine/volatile_cheats.py::_SANCTIONED_UNWRITTEN_PADS; pursue an honest producer for the sp+0x18..0x37 untouched region instead.
